name: dstw_reservoir_manifold
description: Hollow BRCK/INSL basin filled with DSTW, draining through N PIPE(DSTW) offtakes.
why: Build-lessons 'use DSTW, not WATR, for coolant that touches conductors or logic': the plant runs its whole condenser/reservoir loop on DSTW because it does not conduct SPRK; this module is the generic non-conductive reservoir with a manifold of pipe offtakes armed to the same ctype.
source: save2, DSTW reservoir + PIPE manifold x480-600 y302-330
